svg.title: Proof. Unitary conjugation preserves sums, products, the unit, adjoints and norms. It maps the specified generating set onto its target set, so continuity and inverse conjugation give onto recovery of the norm closures. Composition with α maps characters to characters; composition with α−1 is its inverse. The character topology is pointwise evaluation on algebra elements. For each B ∈AZ, the function h(χ)(B) = χ(αB) is continuous, and the same argument applies to the inverse, proving the homeomorphism. By the definition of pushforward, Z h(χ)(B) dρ(χ) = Z η(B) dρZ(η).
